diagnostic.scope: Mechanism diagnostic only; all DNAwalker slots, including the duplicate, retained.

full.scope: Complete development regression, reported separately for each corpus and pooled. No diagnostic subset substitution.

ordering: Within each sequential corpus, shuffle queries with order_seed+corpus_index; rotate the two method labels by query_index modulo 2. Each full corpus has even size and exactly balanced first position counts. Record exact schedule at candidate freeze.
measurement: Original PNML/XML, Rust parse and all property branches within one strict five-second outer invocation. Separate bounded independent Python translation and certificate checking outside solver timing. Portable process-tree RSS sampling with termination at observed 2GiB; not a Linux cgroup guarantee. One local invocation at a time; no benchmarks or builds overlap.
analysis: Retain all planned original slots and unsuccessful outcomes. Report original-slot and exact ordered-branch representative denominators, candidate gains/losses, normalized verdict agreement, failure flags, solver and validator times separately, and PAR-2 charging all nonaccepted outcomes twice budget. Diagnostic and full stages are distinct observations and are never pooled as repetitions.
launch_gate: Preparation never launches a solver. Root must explicitly authorize a prebuilt frozen candidate before run diagnostic or run full. Full stage additionally requires a passing diagnostic artifact audit. Candidate changes require a new campaign directory and freeze; never overwrite prior results.
claim_scope: Single-repeat local development screen. No stable speed, external competitor superiority, held-out generalization, or population confidence claim. No perf counters are collected on this Mac.
